name: Frauke Finsterwalder
bio: Frauke Finsterwalder is a German film director and screenwriter. She has directed several shorts and documentaries.

credits.title: Eurotrash
credits.overview: A writer sets off on a road trip through Switzerland with his drunk and terminally ill mother, after realizing his wealthy family members are the very worst kind of people.

credits.title: Sisi & I
credits.overview: After an elaborate application process, Empress Elisabeth of Austria hires Countess Irma as her new lady-in-waiting and takes her to her summer residence on Corfu. As the two women become closer there, this soon leads to tensions back in Vienna.

credits.title: Finsterworld
credits.overview: The film tells different stories in a kind of parallel Germany about love, affection and hatred.
